title: Stellaris: Staleness-Aware Distributed Reinforcement Learning with Serverless Computing
problem: Distributed DRL training demands considerable time and computational resources. Existing distributed DRL solutions rely on synchronous learning with serverful infrastructures, suffering from low training efficiency and overwhelming costs.
motivation: DRL has achieved remarkable success in gaming AI, scientific simulations, and HPC system scheduling, making efficient distributed training critical for scaling these applications.
method: Stellaris introduces an asynchronous learning paradigm for distributed DRL training with serverless computing. It employs importance sampling truncation to stabilize training under asynchronous conditions and develops a staleness-aware gradient aggregation method that adapts to dynamic staleness from varying worker delays in serverless environments.
key_novelty: First generic asynchronous learning paradigm for distributed DRL training with serverless computing.
contributions: Asynchronous learning paradigm for distributed DRL leveraging serverless computing
Importance sampling truncation technique for stabilizing asynchronous DRL training
Staleness-aware gradient aggregation method for dynamic delay handling
Achieves 2.2x higher rewards and 41% cost reduction versus state-of-the-art baselines
primary_theme: asynchronous distributed reinforcement learning with serverless computing
